title: Bitcoin node count reaches new highs as decentralization str
content:
TL;DR: Bitcoin's network is witnessing a significant increase in full node count, signaling a robust strengthening of its decentralized foundation. This surge in independent validators, alongside a formidable hashrate of 983.87 EH/s and stable difficulty at 146.47 T, reinforces Bitcoin's resilience against censorship and external control. For transactors, this means greater security and a clear imperative to run your own node, anchoring your financial sovereignty.

Is Bitcoin's Surging Node Count a True Measure of Decentralization?
